import random,sys,bisect
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from main import canonical_runs, U
random.seed(999)
for trial in range(500):
    routes={}
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,50)):
        l=random.randint(0,128); size=1<<(128-l)
        st=(random.getrandbits(128)//size)*size
        routes[(st,l)]=random.randint(0,20)
    starts,hops=canonical_runs(routes)
    def brute(a):
        best=None; bl=-1
        for (st,l),hp in routes.items():
            mask=((1<<l)-1) << (128-l) if l else 0
            if (a & mask)==st and l>=bl:
                bl=l; best=hp
        return best
    # test every run start and random points inside, plus near high U
    probes=set(starts)
    for _ in range(100): probes.add(random.getrandbits(128))
    for x in probes:
        idx=bisect.bisect_right(starts,x)-1
        got=hops[idx]
        exp=brute(x)
        if got!=exp:
            print('FAIL',trial,hex(x),got,exp,starts,hops)
            raise SystemExit(1)
print('LPM brute PASS')
